name: Allow clicking on "levels"
description: In any place in settings where we have a header for project and global levels, allow the user to click on them to switch tabs.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/123 — Level tabs are clickable in Stages, Custom Fields and Stage Prompts, preserving keyboard switching and disabling clicks during forms/dialogs. Documentation updated and real-TUI screenshots uploaded. Validation accepted: typecheck, lint, 76 unit tests, 20 CLI tests and build passed. Head: 03a5221; CI pending.
